subject: Discovery recap + propose technical deep dive windows
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Dana Liu <dana.liu@medtechlabs.com>, Tom Becker <tom.becker@medtechlabs.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + propose technical deep dive windows

Hi Dana / Tom —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned before a technical deep dive:

- Primary goal: reduce per-request latency for clinical transcription workflows and add embedding-based similarity search for the triage UI.
- Constraints: on-prem data residency for PHI, expect peak concurrency of ~120 req/s, average sequence lengths ~1.5k tokens.
- Success criteria: 99th pctl latency < 350ms for 512-token responses; embedding recall > 0.88 on current eval set.

Next steps I suggest: a 60–75 minute technical deep dive with your engineering + security leads and one of our serving/runtime engineers. During that session we’ll:
- Walk architecture fit, routing and fallback options (hosted vs private), and security controls (KMS/HSM, audit logs)
- Share preliminary performance expectations for a representative workload and discuss autoscaling policy
- Review mutual action plan and timeline for a POC (if we agree to proceed)

Can you confirm two windows that work for your team next week? Proposed slots I tentatively hold:
- Tue 30 May, 10:00–11:15 PT
- Wed 31 May, 14:00–15:15 PT

If neither works, tell me 2–3 windows that do and who from your side will attend (engineering, security, product). I’ll coordinate a calendar invite and include a short agenda.

Attaching a one-pager agenda draft.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment: REDWOOD_DEMO_AGENDA.pdf (1 page)

Rishi —

Appreciate the clear recap. Both slots are possible for us but the team prefers Wed 31 May 14:00–15:15 PT. Attendees from MedTech Labs:
- Dana Liu (VP Product)

- Priya Nayar (Security & Privacy) — she’s confirming availability but expects to join

A couple of items to add to the agenda:

We prefer Google Meet if that’s ok. If you can send the calendar invite with the meet link and include any required pre-reads, we’ll lock it in.
